description: This file contains the implementation of a CKEditor dialog for creating and editing radio button input elements within the CKEditor plugin system.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Prepares the dialog by identifying and setting up the selected radio button element when the dialog is shown.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Creates a new radio input element or inserts an existing one into the editor content when the dialog is confirmed.

methods.name: setupContent
methods.description: Configures the dialog fields with the properties of the selected radio button element.

methods.name: commitContent
methods.description: Saves the dialog input values back into the radio button element.
